candidates.headline: What Cowboys-Packers' Micah Parsons trade means a year later
candidates.description: We examine the fallout and lingering impact on both franchises more than a year after the blockbuster deal.

candidates.headline: Seahawks sticking with Sam Darnold as starter despite INTs
candidates.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald is standing behind Sam Darnold as the team's starting quarterback despite his seven interceptions over the past four games.

candidates.headline: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson; Tyler Huntley to start vs. Browns
candidates.description: The Ravens have ruled quarterback Lamar Jackson out for a second straight week, elevating Tyler Huntley to the starting role for Sunday's game in Cleveland.

candidates.headline: Rams' Alaric Jackson has suspension cut to 1 game following appeal
candidates.description: Alaric Jackson's suspension for punching Bradley Chubb after Monday night's game between the Bills and Rams has been reduced from two games to one.

candidates.headline: Jaguars WR Parker Washington has the clutch gene: Will that earn him an extension?
candidates.description: Did you see Washington's one-handed grab in London? How did he get so good at contested catches? And how did he quickly become a big part of the Jaguars' offense?

candidates.headline: Zxavian Harris eligible to sign with NFL teams despite bid to play for LSU
candidates.description: The NFL has reversed course and now says that former Ole Miss DL Zxavian Harris is free to sign with teams this season after a failed attempt to return to college football at LSU.

candidates.headline: Marvin Harrison Jr. latest in Texans' quest to solve their WR2 conundrum
candidates.description: Houston has traded and drafted receivers, hoping to complement No. 1 wideout Nico Collins and QB C.J. Stroud.

candidates.headline: Source: Packers lose DT Javon Hargrave for season to torn Achilles
candidates.description: Tests confirmed Monday that Packers defensive tackle Javon Hargrave suffered a season-ending torn Achilles in Sunday's victory over the Bears, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

candidates.headline: Making sense of the Giants-Commanders tie, the Texans' Marvin Harrison Jr. trade
candidates.description: What were the Commanders doing in the final minute of OT? Why did the 1-4 Texans make an aggressive trade for Marvin Harrison Jr.? Let's try to find the logic.

candidates.headline: Sources: Cardinals finalizing deal to trade WR Marvin Harrison Jr.
candidates.description: The Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade Marvin Harrison Jr., sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

candidates.headline: Colts place DE Arden Key on IR with hamstring injury
candidates.description: Colts defensive end Arden Key has been placed on injured reserve with a hamstring injury, meaning he will miss at least four games before returning to the active roster.

candidates.headline: Sources: Ravens held Cam Jurgens physical before trade with Eagles
candidates.description: As the Ravens and Eagles were preparing to agree to a trade that would send Cam Jurgens to Baltimore, the two sides made immediate plans for the center to undergo a physical in Philadelphia before any deal was finalized, league sources told ESPN.

candidates.headline: Eagles release QB Andy Dalton after costly pick, demotion
candidates.description: Andy Dalton, who lost his spot as the Eagles' backup quarterback following a costly interception against the Bears, has been released.

candidates.headline: Don't be surprised if: Unsung heroes rack up the stats, and one QB to trade away
candidates.description: Don't be surprised if the trade market for a QB1 drops off after Week 5, and unsung heroes start to shine.

candidates.headline: Undrafted rookie QB Daniels savors Thursday night win vs. Cowboys
candidates.description: Jalon Daniels became the first undrafted rookie starting QB in the common draft era to win a game for a team that entered winless, leading the Bucs to a 24-16 win over the Cowboys.

candidates.headline: TE Sam LaPorta says extension talks with Lions at 'stalemate'
candidates.description: Lions tight end Sam LaPorta is currently focused on the 2026 season but acknowledged for the first time after Wednesday's practice that he has broken off contract talks on an extension.

candidates.headline: Is it time to panic about 49ers' injuries? Breaking down IR, trade deadline plan
candidates.description: The 49ers are again among the most injured teams in the NFL. We answered questions about their injuries and how they will affect the 2026 season.

candidates.headline: Ravens acquire center Cam Jurgens in trade with Eagles
candidates.description: The Ravens have acquired two-time Pro Bowl center Cam Jurgens in a trade with the Eagles.

candidates.headline: Tyreek Hill's wife recounts assault, verbal abuse at trial
candidates.description: Tyreek Hill's wife recounted details of assault and verbal abuse during testimony Tuesday on the first day of a civil assault and battery trial in Florida, proceedings that began a day after ESPN reported Hill would potentially sign an NFL contract soon.

candidates.headline: Giants' Berrios says he'll undergo season-ending foot surgery
candidates.description: Giants receiver Braxton Berrios will undergo season-ending surgery on his foot, he announced Tuesday on Instagram.

candidates.headline: Vikings LG Jackson likely out for season, LT Darrisaw has concussion
candidates.description: Vikings left guard Donovan Jackson is headed for what is likely season-ending surgery to repair a meniscus tear in his knee, and left tackle Christian Darrisaw is in the concussion protocol.

candidates.headline: Sources: Packers LB Edgerrin Cooper has torn Achilles
candidates.description: Packers linebacker Edgerrin Cooper suffered a season-ending Achilles tear during Sunday's 17-14 victory over the Buccaneers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

candidates.headline: Ben Johnson: Tyson Bagent will start at QB for Bears vs. Packers
candidates.description: Tyson Bagent will be the Bears' starting quarterback for Sunday's game at the Packers, coach Ben Johnson announced Monday.

candidates.headline: Tyreek Hill could sign with new team soon, agent says
candidates.description: Free agent wide receiver Tyreek Hill could sign with a new team "over the next few days," his agent, Drew Rosenhaus, told ESPN's Adam Schefter. Hill's former team, the Chiefs, are believed to be one of those interested.

candidates.headline: Sources: Steelers' contract philosophy led to Joey Porter Jr. trade
candidates.description: The Steelers' philosophy of avoiding second-year contract guarantees was a factor in their inability to reach a deal with Joey Porter Jr., sources told NFL Network.

candidates.headline: Patriots preach patience when it comes to receiver WR Romeo Doubs' modest start
candidates.description: After the Patriots signed him to a four-year deal in March, Doubs is searching for his footing in the offense entering Week 4.

candidates.headline: Bears LT Braxton Jones on IR; Theo Benedet to start vs. Jets
candidates.description: Bears left tackle Braxton Jones has been placed on injured reserve after sustaining an injury to his right knee against the Eagles in Week 3.

candidates.headline: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba off to a historic start, but is it sustainable?
candidates.description: Seattle's star receiver is leading the NFL in receiving yards and TDs after signing a big contract extension this summer. But will the Seahawks look to spread the ball more?

candidates.headline: Joey Porter Jr. without designation, could debut for Cowboys
candidates.description: Newly acquired Cowboys cornerback Joey Porter Jr. does not carry an injury designation after practicing the past two days following his trade from the Steelers.

candidates.headline: McCarthy: Trade to Giants a 'shock,' turns page on Vikings
candidates.description: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy said it was a "shock" to be traded from the Vikings to the Giants this week but is looking at it as an opportunity to show what he can do.

candidates.headline: Bears coach Ben Johnson not ready to name QB starter
candidates.description: Bears coach Ben Johnson will not say whether Case Keenum or Tyson Bagent will start Sunday against the Jets.

candidates.headline: Don't be surprised if ... these three hot starters continue to shine all season
candidates.description: Don't be surprised if a few early stars stay hot, and if a slow-starting QB enjoys a big Week 4.

candidates.headline: Why Matthew Stafford made a cameo in Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' music video
candidates.description: Why, yes, that was Matthew Stafford. Here's why all signs pointed to the reigning NFL MVP's music video cameo.

candidates.headline: Why Steelers traded Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys, what's next?
candidates.description: Our insiders dive into Porter's fit in Dallas, his potential for a contract extension and what's next for the Steelers.

candidates.headline: NFL trade deadline grades: Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys, J.J. McCarthy to Giants
candidates.description: Can Joey Porter Jr. clean up the Cowboys' defense? Will J.J. McCarthy improve the Giants' QB situation? We're grading NFL trades ahead of November's deadline.

candidates.headline: Steelers end standoff, trade Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys
candidates.description: The Steelers traded cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder.

candidates.headline: Falcons sign DT Gervon Dexter Sr. to four-year extension
candidates.description: The Falcons signed Gervon Dexter Sr. to a four-year, $78 million contract extension, sources told ESPN.

candidates.headline: Packers WR Jayden Reed to undergo season-ending neck surgery
candidates.description: Packers wide receiver Jayden Reed will undergo season-ending neck surgery and be placed on injured reserve, coach Matt LaFleur said Wednesday.

candidates.headline: Giants' Harbaugh explains reasoning for releasing Beckham
candidates.description: Giants coach John Harbaugh on Wednesday explained the team's decision for releasing wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr.

candidates.headline: Packers, guard Kevin Zeitler agree to one-year deal
candidates.description: Veteran guard Kevin Zeitler signed a one-year deal with the Packers.
